flags: Venue abroad (Spain): prices are in EUR, shown in USD at 1 EUR = 1.0935 USD (2026-11-25). Our Bay Area price sheet does not apply abroad: lines the venue has not priced show unknown (ask the venue or a local supplier). European prices may already include VAT (IVA). Ask.

notes.t: From the venue's documents: cocktail eur pp vat incl: 60_min: 27, 90_min: 37
From the venue's documents: bodega eur pp: 25 EUR

From the venue's documents: computed seated example eur pp: 126 EUR (Computed by us, not a venue figure: 60-min cocktail €27 + cheapest starter €16 + cheapest fish €21 + dessert €9 + Bodega €25 + open bar €28 = €126 per adult, VAT included, before rooms and the €8,000 + VAT exclusive-use fee.)
Capacity: 230 guests
40 rooms, sleeps 80 people
Music until 5:00 am with exclusive use, otherwise 3:00 am
Exclusive use runs 4 pm on the wedding day to noon the next day
Wedding services are priced in the brochure; room prices are not shown
Open Saturdays: 10 and 17 April 2027, 30 October 2027
Recommends a Spain-based wedding planner for couples from abroad

Website check: Site pages read did not state capacity or room count (they are in the linked 2027 dossier PDF, not read). Email figures (230 dining, 40 rooms / 80 guests) stand unverified. Topas is the municipality per OpenStreetMap.
Guest minimum: 100 adults May to October; 65 adults November to April
Banquet spaces: Castle Courtyard 160 (needs exclusive use), Ullóa 35, Fonseca 70, El Cenador 230
Cocktail spaces: Courtyard/Cloister 140, Courtyard + Liza 230, Liza 190, Gardens 250
Civil ceremony set-up €500 (30 chairs) or €800 (80 chairs + lemonade)
Cocktail reception €27 pp (60 min) or €37 pp (90 min), VAT included; children 4-12 €14
Brochure prices include VAT (the €8,000 exclusive-use fee in the email is + VAT)
Cocktail in the Cloister costs €500 extra; last courtyard cocktail starts 7:00 PM
Banquet dishes priced each: starters €16-32, fish €21-26, meat €24-27, desserts €9, sorbets €6.50; pick at least 2 courses + dessert
Wine package Bodega Castillo €25 pp (soft drinks, beer, water, coffee included)
Open bar €28 per adult for first 3 hours, then €6 pp per hour; teens €14 then €3
Open bar ends 11:00 pm for daytime weddings, 5:00 am for evening weddings; starts right after the banquet
Late-night snack €6 pp (Spanish) or €8.50 pp (American)
Cocktail-style banquet (no seated dinner) €79 pp + at least 3 stations; enhanced seating €8 pp (garden only)
Cocktail stations €4-9.50 pp (beer €4, champagne €9, cheese €7, rice €6.50, BBQ €9.50); Iberian ham with cutter €750
Children's menu €38 (drink and bread included)
In-house kitchen; everything cooked the same day; chefs Nerea Hernández and Mario Martínez
Wedding cake always included, served during the open bar
Deposit €2,000; 40% at least 6 months before, 40% at 90 days, 20% at 15 days; bank transfer only
Only one wedding per day
These conditions apply to 2027 weddings of 100+ guests; smaller ones get a custom quote
Room packages on request; exclusive use books all rooms, bed and breakfast
Courtesies for 100+ guests: wedding night suite, tasting for 6 (menu over €90), menus and seating printed, special guest room prices, cake cutting
Candy bar €2.60 pp (classic) or €4.80 pp (deluxe), minimum 100 guests
20 minutes from Salamanca, 2 hours from Madrid
Older Spanish dossier lists El Cenador up to 280 diners (2027 English brochure says 230)
